_meta.indication: Adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age or older.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study with a 4-week baseline period, 3-week titration period, and 12-week maintenance period comparing placebo and three target maintenance doses of ONFI.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients age 2-54 years with a current or prior diagnosis of LGS, stratified into 2 weight groups.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Percent reduction in the weekly frequency of drop seizures (atonic, tonic, or myoclonic) from the 4-week baseline period to the 12-week maintenance period.
pivotal_trials.result: Mean percent reduction in weekly drop seizure rate: placebo -12.1, low -41.2, medium -49.4, high -68.3; all ONFI dose groups statistically superior to placebo (p<=0.05).

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind comparison of high- and low-dose ONFI with a 4-week baseline, 3-week titration, and 4-week maintenance period.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients age 2-25 years with a current or prior diagnosis of LGS, stratified into 2 weight groups.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Percent reduction in the weekly frequency of drop seizures from the 4-week baseline period to the 4-week maintenance period.
pivotal_trials.result: Statistically significantly greater reduction in the high-dose group vs the low-dose group (median percent reduction of 93% vs 29%; p<0.05).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (any ONFI dose) include somnolence or sedation (26% vs 15% placebo), pyrexia (13% vs 3%), upper respiratory tract infection (12% vs 10%), and lethargy (10% vs 5%); serious postmarketing reactions include Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) and toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN).
target_moa: Clobazam is a 1,5-benzodiazepine; its exact mechanism is not fully understood but is thought to involve potentiation of GABAAergic neurotransmission via binding at the benzodiazepine site of the GABAA receptor.

rems.type: FDA determined that a REMS is not necessary for Onfi to ensure that its benefits outweigh its risks.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile is similar to that of other drugs approved for this indication.

orphan_indication.text: Clobazam was designated an orphan drug for Lennox-Gastaut syndrome; orphan drug designation was awarded on 18 December 2007.

summary.text: ONFI (clobazam) NDA 202067 was submitted by Lundbeck on December 23, 2010 for adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome in patients 2 years and older; it had orphan drug designation (awarded December 2007), was not referred to an advisory committee, and was approved in 2011 based on pivotal study OV-1012 and supportive study OV-1002, with carcinogenicity and reproductive toxicity postmarketing requirements imposed.

citations.quote: NDA 202067, for the use of ONFI (clobazam) Tablets, 5, 10, and 20 mg, for the adjunctive treatment of Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age and older, was submitted by Lundbeck, Inc. on 12/23/10.
clobazam was designated an orphan drug for LGS in December, 2007.
Your application for Onfi was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile is similar to that of other drugs approved for this indication.

The two clobazam clinical efficacy studies which support the proposed indication of adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) are the pivotal study OV-1012 and the supportive study OV-1002.
